raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 11  
Reason for Mistake: The error took place when the Planner incorrectly concluded that both Laleli Mosque and Esma Sultan Mansion were located in the same neighborhood, based on information provided by WebSurfer. This was a misinterpretation of the gathered data: the WebSurfer correctly identified Esma Sultan Mansion as being located in the Ortaköy neighborhood, Beşiktaş district, not the Laleli neighborhood, Fatih district as asserted by the Planner. This mistake in neighborhood identification by the Planner led to the incorrect final conclusion that both sites were in the same neighborhood.
